STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] DOWN: Bearish Momentum Persists as Tech Valuation Concerns Weigh on Index
tldr_points: Technical breakdown shows S&P 500 trading below its 20-day moving average at 7,737.04, signaling near-term bearish momentum.
Fundamental catalysts are heavily negative, driven by Alphabet's historic selloff and broader tech sector multiple compression.
RSI-14 at 42.11 indicates room for further downside before reaching oversold conditions, suggesting a continuation of the bear trend.
STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 bearish on tech multiple compression and breakdown below the 20-day moving average.
STOCKS.comment: Bearish momentum persists as the index trades below the 20-day MA amid severe tech valuation headwinds.

CRYPTO.title: [BTC/USD] DOWN: Binance Hack Sparks Sell-Off as Technicals Break Key Support
tldr_points: Bitcoin faces immediate headwinds following the Binance hack investigation with suspicious outflows reaching up to $5.8 billion.
Technical indicators show BTC trading below its 20-day moving average at $81,614.20 with RSI-14 at 33.49, signaling bearish momentum.
Institutional interest persists as NYSE parent ICE moves to integrate Hyperliquid perps, providing a mixed backdrop for altcoins.
CRYPTO.excerpt: Bitcoin slides below support amid Binance hack concerns, trading below MA20 with bearish momentum persisting.
CRYPTO.comment: Bearish trend confirmed below MA20 with RSI showing room for further downside amid exchange security concerns.
